name: Nikki Pascarl
title: Psychologist, EMDRAA Accredited Practitioner
description: Nikki takes a respectful and non-judgemental approach of all people regardless of history, ethnicity or culture, subculture, LGBTIQA+, neurodiversity, internal system structure, and the intersectionality of any/all of the above. Her primary framework is Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). Clinical focus: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Complex PTSD, Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID), Otherwise Specified Dissociative Disorder (OSDD), Borderline Personality Disorder, attachment wounds, childhood trauma, abuse & neglect, and domestic violence.
specialties: DID, OSDD, internal system structure, EMDR, PTSD, complex PTSD, childhood trauma, attachment, BPD, LGBTIQA+, neurodiversity, supervision

name: Martin Mitrevski
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Martin is a clinical psychologist and board-approved supervisor providing services to adults (18+) in areas including Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Complex PTSD (cPTSD), Dissociative Spectrum Disorder, OCD, grief, substance use and emotion regulation. Therapeutic approaches include CBT, ACT, DBT, Schema Therapy, Eye-Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) Therapy, and Parts-Work (Structural Dissociation Model of Personality, Internal Family Systems). Medicare provider.
specialties: dissociative disorders, structural dissociation, parts work, IFS, EMDR, schema therapy, PTSD, complex PTSD, DBT
